item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 01/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Saola will move across the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary today and tomorrow. It will be windy with frequent heavy squally showers and storm surge over the region. Seas will be high with swells. Saola will depart and weaken gradually thereafter, but under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will still be showers over the coast of southern China early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Haikui will move across the seas east of Taiwan in the next couple of days, and edge closer to vicinity of the coast of Fujian and eastern Guangdong midweek next week.
